search_method: black-box random search / basin-hopping, 8 restarts x 150 iters/restart
caveat: Perturbations are clipped to physically valid SENSOR READING bounds, but this does NOT verify a real operator could ACHIEVE a given perturbation (e.g. how much RCS reduction a given amount of RAM coating buys is a separate, harder question, not modeled here) -- same limitation the physically-motivated tests in robustness.py sidestep by testing named real countermeasures at fixed severities instead of a free-form search.
